conditions.scope: Sandbox client presentation for Luxium 2.8.0-pre-alpha, Embeddium 0.3.31 and Oculus 1.8.0.

change.summary: Route Video Settings directly to Embeddium and keep Luxium-owned actions inside the existing Luxium page.

modifiers.before: Luxium wraps Embeddium's selected video screen in a separate VideoSettingsHubScreen.
modifiers.after: Video Settings opens Embeddium directly and the existing Luxium page contains the renderer toggle, full Luxium settings action and upstream YouTube artwork.

modifiers.before: JEM Luxium changes Luxium's master enabled setting and rebuilds Embeddium, but leaves LuxiumGpuShaderFeatures on the feature mask cached while Luxium was disabled at startup.
modifiers.after: Every owner change refreshes LuxiumGpuShaderFeatures, reloads native core shaders through Luxium's GameRendererAccessor and rebuilds Embeddium. A bounded world/master-change snapshot logs actual sky feature, mode, frame and cascade generations. Runtime shadow acceptance is still pending.

modifiers.before: AutoModpack distributes luxium-client.toml with luxiumEnabled=false and can overwrite the player's renderer selection.
modifiers.after: Luxium generates and owns its personal client config locally. AutoModpack no longer distributes luxium-client.toml.

modifiers.before: The previous local preset enabled direct hard cubemap shadows at 42 blocks with 32 sources alongside celestial shadows
modifiers.after: A one-time client migration disables the exact expensive local preset when celestial shadows are selected. Native sun and moon shadows take precedence, with ordinary block illumination
modifiers.notes: Keep the renderer selection, native Luxium config ownership and optional local modes

modifiers.before: The default Oculus preference enabled shaders, so the JEM bridge selected Oculus over native Luxium
modifiers.after: Sandbox can start with native Luxium celestial shadows. The managed pack uses Oculus with shaders off by default and preserves the player's editable preference
modifiers.notes: Only the fresh renderer default replaces the historical Jalloween shader selection. The title and optional shader pack are unchanged.

modifiers.before: Neo Voxy runs its ordinary LOD projection during Luxium's Embeddium shadow pass and writes depth into the celestial cascade framebuffer
modifiers.after: Neo Voxy skips viewport setup inside the Luxium celestial terrain pass. Native Embeddium terrain fills the cascade and Voxy still renders the main world
conditions: Neo Voxy 0.4.0beta Forge with Luxium 2.8.0 celestial terrain capture

rationale.purpose: Remove one redundant navigation page while preserving native Embeddium and Luxium interfaces.
rationale.decision_source: User request dated 2026-10-28 based on the supplied current Luxium hub screenshot.
rationale.user_requested: Open Embeddium immediately and place the Luxium settings button on the second row with the YouTube artwork below.
rationale.codex_choices: Use a lower-priority narrow OptionsScreen argument adapter, Embeddium's native option row contract and the official Luxium configuration class and texture from the installed JAR.

introduced.summary: Bypass the Luxium hub after Embeddium selection and rehome the upstream actions inside the Luxium page.

history.summary: Open Embeddium directly, place full Luxium settings on row two and render the official YouTube artwork below.
Move the bypass to Luxium's intermediate VideoSettingsHubScreen so the native Options button reaches Embeddium immediately without relying on a conflicting OptionsScreen redirect.
Refresh Luxium's cached GPU feature mask before every renderer rebuild and stop distributing its personal client config.

Complete the native Apply lifecycle with core shader reload and bounded render-state diagnostics after the user reported persistent missing shadows. The complete player-visible cause remains under investigation.
Track the installed Luxium compatibility artifact that defers reconciliation until world entry.
Restore the native celestial shadow default for the exact preset linked to the measured torch slowdown. Keep future personal settings editable.
Keep the Voxy depth compositing pass outside the Luxium celestial framebuffer
Retain the standalone adapter for Sandbox and remove it from the managed pack.

relations: Vanilla Options video action -> direct Embeddium screen
Embeddium Luxium tab -> renderer toggle -> native Apply lifecycle
Luxium Apply -> refresh GPU feature mask -> rebuild Embeddium renderer
Embeddium Luxium tab second row -> official LuxiumConfigScreen
Embeddium Luxium tab lower action -> official Luxium YouTube resource -> confirmation screen
notes: The official Luxium JAR remains unmodified and supplies the complete settings screen and YouTube texture.
Luxium and Oculus mutual exclusion and shader restoration remain unchanged.
The managed pack no longer owns luxium-client.toml, so a player's renderer selection survives independently of pack updates.
unresolved: Runtime navigation, row layout, focus order, link confirmation and immediate shadow activation remain unobserved until authorized player testing.
Player acceptance of sun and moon shadows and frame rate after migrating the exact legacy preset is pending
Nearby terrain shadow appearance after the Voxy capture guard requires player acceptance. Distant Voxy meshes have no native Luxium receiver
